fact.title: muscle:grep--n-cd
fact.body:
### Context
The same 3-command sequence was observed 2× in this session (shadow-worker repetition detection).

### Steps
- grep -n "GLOBAL_FLAG_PATTERN" -B2 -A2 /c/Users/jaroslav/.pi/agent/git/github.com/mastnacek/pi-plugin-dev/src/config-cascade-auditor.ts | head -10
- cd /d/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-lotusscript-modular && sed -n '1,40p' src/slices/linter/modal.ts
- cd /d/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-lotusscript-modular && grep -n "notify\|ui\." src/slices/tools/compile-tool.ts src/slices/tools/scaffold-tool.ts | head
- grep -n "USES_TABLE" -A 5 /c/Users/jaroslav/.pi/agent/git/github.com/mastnacek/pi-plugin-dev/src/i18n-auditor.ts | head -12
- cd /d/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-lotusscript-modular && rm src/slices/tools/gotchas-params.ts
- cd /d/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-lotusscript-modular && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK && npm test 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|ALL|PASSED|Passed" | head

### Rule
Run the sequence as one motor chunk with `uma muscle run grep--n-cd --confirm`.
